items.name: Backpack
items.effect: Adds 2 to carrying capacity. One per person.
items.description: A sturdy backpack made of leather and canvas, perfect for carrying supplies on long journeys.

items.name: Barrel
items.effect: Room for 15 weight units. Armor rating 3, breaks after 10 damage.
items.description: A large wooden barrel, often used for storing liquids or bulk goods.

items.name: Basket
items.description: A woven basket, useful for carrying small items or gathering food.

items.name: Bottle
items.description: A glass bottle, perfect for holding potions or other liquids.

items.name: Chest
items.effect: Room for 20 weight units. Armor rating 5, breaks after 25 damage.
items.description: A sturdy wooden chest, often used for storing valuables or treasure.

items.name: Clay Jug
items.description: A clay jug, useful for holding liquids or food.

items.name: Saddle Bag
items.effect: Adds 2 to an animal's carrying capacity, up to two bags per animal.
items.description: A leather bag designed to be strapped to a saddle, perfect for carrying supplies on horseback.
